expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Declares a covariant soft reference to an object of type T. Declares a covariant soft reference to a class derived from T. Constructs a null soft object reference. Constructs a soft object reference from an unloaded asset path. @param Path Asset path retained without forcing the object to load. Implicitly constructs a soft reference from a loaded object. @param Object Loaded object used to establish the reference. Copies another soft object reference. Synchronously loads and returns the object in editor builds; unavailable for runtime gameplay. Constructs a null soft class reference. Constructs a soft class reference from an unloaded class path. @param Path Class asset path retained without forcing the class to load. Constructs a soft class reference from a loaded UClass. @param Object Loaded class constrained to derive from T.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
testScope: TSoftObjectPtr<T> ObjectRef; | TSoftClassPtr<T> ClassRef; | TSoftObjectPtr<T> Value(); | TSoftObjectPtr<T> Value(const FSoftObjectPath& Path); | TSoftObjectPtr<T> Value(T Object); | TSoftObjectPtr<T> Value(const TSoftObjectPtr<T>& Other); | T TSoftObjectPtr<T>.EditorOnlyLoadSynchronous() const; | TSoftClassPtr<T> Value(); | TSoftClassPtr<T> Value(const FSoftObjectPath& Path); | TSoftClassPtr<T> Value(UClass Object);
